processing: Mono 16 kHz, 5.6 kHz low-pass, 10-bit quantization stored as 16-bit PCM. A consistent SNES-style sample-bank aesthetic; not hardware BRR encoding.
adaptation: Short Japanese voice excerpts, 85 Hz high-pass, 210 Hz presence EQ, compression, pitch-preserving tempo, level matching and 12/60 ms edge fades. Final Flash retains its brief energy tail; Kakarotto is isolated from the end of Vegeta’s challenge.
credit: Original Dragon Ball performances and game audio retain their respective rights; not covered by the project code license.
